deviceAlerts.pitch: Know when a print fails, runs out of filament or finishes.
deviceAlerts.viaBridge: Sent through the bridge, even when the browser is closed.
deviceAlerts.tabOnly: Alerts only come while Cloud Slicer is open in a tab. Through a bridge they come with the browser closed too.
deviceAlerts.iosHome: On iPhone and iPad, alerts work once Cloud Slicer is on your Home Screen: tap Share, then Add to Home Screen, and open it from there (iOS 16.4 or later).
deviceAlerts.unsupported: This browser can’t show alerts. Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Safari can.
deviceAlerts.denied: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in the browser’s site settings, then turn alerts on again.
deviceAlerts.relay: The bridge’s relay can’t send alerts yet.
deviceAlerts.connectFirst: Connect to the printer to change its alerts.
deviceAlerts.stripHelp: Tap the strip under an alert to choose its cameras.
deviceAlerts.picturesHelp: Several cameras are joined into one picture. Pictures from a bridge printer need its bridge up to date (Update now in Printers and bridges).
deviceAlerts.picturesIos: iPhone shows alerts without the picture.
deviceAlerts.tapMore: Tap more cameras to join them into one picture.
deviceAlerts.startedWithLast: Started with the alerts you chose last time. Change them here for this device.
deviceAlerts.noSubscription: This browser did not make a push subscription.
deviceAlerts.toggleAgain: Turn alerts off and on again on this device.
deviceAlerts.testSent: Sent. It should show in a few seconds.
